item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 1-1 Burton U18
item.description: Mansfield Town under-18s extended their unbeaten run in the Youth Alliance League North on Saturday, as they drew 1-1 with Burton Albion at RH Academy. The young Stags enjoyed the better of the first half and took a merited lead into the interval, courtesy of forward Zidan Ali’s first goal for the under-18s. item.title: Tyler Roberts signs permanent contract with Stags
item.description: Mansfield Town are pleased to announce that Tyler Roberts has signed a permanent contract until the end of the season after leaving Birmingham City. The 27-year-old has impressed during his loan spell with the Stags after joining in September, scoring three goals in nine appearances. “I’m happy where I am at Mansfield right now so to get this one completed made a lot of sense,” said Tyler. “Since I joined on loan I’ve really enjoyed my time here. item.title: Mansfield Town sign Spurs midfielder
item.description: Mansfield Town are delighted to announce the signing of midfielder George Abbott on loan from Tottenham Hotspur until the end of the season. The 20-year-old joined Spurs as a seven-year-old and rose through the ranks before making his senior debut for the club in 4-1 Premier League win over Leeds in 2023. item.title: Max Dickov joins Tranmere on loan
item.description: Mansfield Town forward Max Dickov has joined Sky Bet League Two outfit Tranmere Rovers on loan until the end of the season.The 23-year-old has made four starts in League One for the Stags and 10 substitute appearances this season as well as outings in the Emirates FA Cup, Carabao Cup and Vertu Trophy.The club wishes Max every success in his loan spell at Prenton Park.

item.title: Rotherham rearranged game ticket information
item.description: Tickets for our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Rotherham United on Tuesday 03 March will go on general sale from 10am on Monday 09 February. Tickets purchased for the original fixture will remain valid for the rearranged date. The match will kick-off at 7.45pm. From the original allocation of 2,297 tickets, 580 are still available to purchase on a first-come first-served basis. The game – originally scheduled to take place on Sunday 04 January – was postponed due to a frozen pitch at AESSEAL

item.title: Kick-off time brought forward for Doncaster match
item.description: Our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Doncaster Rovers on Friday 03 April will now kick-off at the earlier time of 12.30pm. The Good Friday contest was originally scheduled to kick-off at 3pm but has now been brought forward after both clubs agreed to an earlier kick-off time. Ticket information for the fixture will be announced in due course.
